new_series.title: Morning Live
new_series.synopsis: Find out if you could be owed money for unclaimed premium bonds and whether there is a correct way to stack a dishwasher.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: Joe Buck, a naïve young Texan, leaves his dead-end job to be a hustler in 1960s New York, where he forms a bond with Rico, a physically broken con man. With very strong language.

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Nathan Filer explores how the language of neurodiversity has evolved – offering a sense of belonging for many, while raising difficult questions about difference and diagnosis.

new_series.title: Limelight
new_series.synopsis: After agreeing to help a mysterious stranger, young couple Jake and Kayla are implicated in an assassination at their hotel. A global thriller of espionage, money and murder.

new_series.title: Everything Is Fake
new_series.synopsis: Podcasting has made some people famous very fast. Look closely at how they got there, and you see something revealing about the world we now live in. Jamie Bartlett investigates.

new_series.title: All the Beauty in the World by Patrick Bringley
new_series.synopsis: A portrait of the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York and the moving story of one guard's quest to find solace and meaning in art.

new_series.title: The History Podcast
new_series.synopsis: Hidden on page 1692 of his great-grandfather Siegfried’s unpublished memoir, the writer Joe Dunthorne discovers a confession.

new_series.title: Broken Colours
new_series.synopsis: Jess meets Dan and falls in love. It changes both of their lives. But who is Dan? Holli Dempsey and Josef Altin star in a new thriller from the creator of Tracks, Matthew Broughton

new_series.title: The Voice UK
new_series.synopsis: Emma Willis returns with the spinning-chair singing contest, with Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones joined by new coach Kelly Rowland. With only eight places available on each team, the coaches must choose carefully as they search for the UK's most exciting singing talent. Plus, for the first time, the Rewind button gives them the chance to bring back an artist they regret letting go.
